newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dollar ends slightly up in listless trade.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dollar ends slightly up in listless trade.

text.p: The Taiwan dollar finished slightly firmer against its American counterpart on Saturday, pushed up by exporters' U.S. dollar sales, dealers said.
The local unit ended at T$27.493 against Friday's T$27.495 close. Turnover was a light US$27 million in the shortened weekend session.
"The strength of the U.S. dollar overseas caused the Taiwan dollar's early slides, but exporters' activities lifted the local unit to a higher close," said one dealer.
Dealers expected the Taiwan dollar next week to move in a T$27.485-27.505 range. -- Alice Hung (2-5080815)
